newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST-Hong Kong Newspaper Editorials-Apr 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST-Hong Kong Newspaper Editorials-Apr 29.

text.p: There are 63 days to go before the British colony reverts to China. These are highlights of comments in the Hong Kong press. The views expressed are those of the newspapers quoted and do not represent an editorial viewpoint of Reuters.

-- The ECONOMIC JOURNAL said the United States might postpone a decision on the renewal of China's Most Favoured Nation trade status until after July, to allow the return of Hong Kong to Chinese rule to be taken into consideration.

-- The MING PAO DAILY said it was a wise move by the pro-Beijing Federation of Trade Unions to propose banning local political groups from receiving funds from the Chinese Communist Party. It warned that limiting overseas political contributions was a complicated issue that the office of future leader Tung Chee-hwa should not try to settle in a rush.

-- The English-language SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST said Beijing's determination to clear out thousands of unproductive state companies demonstrated that President Jiang Zemin had consolidated his position and had enough authority to impose policies previously curtailed by conservative leaders.
-- The Beijing-funded TA KUNG PAO said that the new strategic partnership between China and Russia would help maintain peace and security in the Asia-Pacific region.
